cards.example_en: We cleaned the classroom ourselves.
cards.example_zh: 我们自己打扫了教室。

cards.example_en: Let's go out and play in the yard.
cards.example_zh: 我们出去到院子里玩吧。

cards.example_en: We waited outside the cinema until the doors opened.
cards.example_zh: 我们在电影院外面一直等到门开了。

cards.example_en: Take the bread out of the oven before it turns too brown.
cards.example_zh: 趁面包还没变得太黄，把它从烤箱里拿出来。

cards.example_en: A plane flew over our school.
cards.example_zh: 一架飞机飞过我们学校上空。

cards.example_en: I have my own desk at home.
cards.example_zh: 我在家有自己的书桌。

cards.example_en: She split a pack of crayons with her younger sister.
cards.example_zh: 她和妹妹合用了一包蜡笔。

cards.example_en: A packet of tea fell out of the shopping bag on the bus.
cards.example_zh: 在公交车上，一小袋茶叶从购物袋里掉了出来。

cards.example_en: The answer key is on the last page of the workbook.
cards.example_zh: 参考答案在练习册的最后一页。

cards.example_en: Sudden pain in his shoulder made him stop swimming.
cards.example_zh: 肩膀突然疼痛，他只好停止游泳。

cards.example_en: Our class will paint the hallway wall this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我们班这个周末要油漆走廊的墙壁。

cards.example_en: I need a new pair of trainers before basketball season starts.
cards.example_zh: 篮球赛季开始前，我需要一双新运动鞋。

cards.example_en: The old palace is now a museum.
cards.example_zh: 那座旧宫殿现在是博物馆。

cards.example_en: He looked pale after the long run.
cards.example_zh: 长跑之后他脸色苍白。

cards.example_en: Sunday breakfast was a hot pancake.
cards.example_zh: 周日早餐是一张热薄饼。

cards.example_en: The panda sat under a tree.
cards.example_zh: 熊猫坐在树下。

cards.example_en: I wrapped the glass in paper so it would not break.
cards.example_zh: 我用纸把玻璃杯包好，免得它碎掉。

cards.example_en: Delete the second paragraph if the essay is too long.
cards.example_zh: 如果作文太长，就删掉第二段。

cards.example_en: Pardon? Could you say that again?
cards.example_zh: 请再说一遍？你能再说一次吗？

cards.example_en: Ask a parent to sign the form before Friday's museum visit.
cards.example_zh: 星期五参观博物馆之前，请一位家长在表格上签字。

cards.example_en: Children flew kites in the park after school.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们放学后在公园里放风筝。

cards.example_en: I understood only the opening part of that story.
cards.example_zh: 那个故事我只读懂了开头的部分。

cards.example_en: My lab partner held the beaker while I poured.
cards.example_zh: 我的实验搭档扶着烧杯，由我来倒。

cards.example_en: We hung balloons in the hall for a birthday party.
cards.example_zh: 我们在礼堂里挂上气球，准备办生日聚会。

cards.example_en: We pass the bakery every day on the way home.
cards.example_zh: 我们每天回家路上都会经过那家面包店。

cards.example_en: The second passage describes a storm at sea.
cards.example_zh: 第二篇短文描写了海上的一场风暴。

cards.example_en: An elderly passenger offered me a seat on the bus.
cards.example_zh: 一位年长的乘客在公交车上把座位让给了我。

cards.example_en: You need a passport to travel abroad.
cards.example_zh: 出国需要护照。

cards.example_en: In past years our school held the fair in May.
cards.example_zh: 过去几年，我们学校都在五月举办义卖会。

cards.example_en: The patient thanked the nurse after the check-up.
cards.example_zh: 检查结束后，病人向护士道了谢。

cards.example_en: I will pay for the noodles with my lunch card.
cards.example_zh: 我要用饭卡付面条的钱。

cards.example_en: We have PE on the playground today.
cards.example_zh: 今天我们在操场上体育课。

cards.example_en: The two villages have lived in peace since the agreement.
cards.example_zh: 自从达成协议后，那两个村子一直生活在和平之中。

cards.example_en: This pear is sweet and juicy.
cards.example_zh: 这个梨又甜又多汁。

cards.example_en: May I borrow your pen?
cards.example_zh: 我可以借你的钢笔吗？

cards.example_en: This pencil is too short for the drawing test.
cards.example_zh: 这支铅笔太短，画画考试不太好用。

cards.example_en: The penguin slid across the ice.
cards.example_zh: 企鹅滑过冰面。

cards.example_en: Lanterns drew people into the square after dark.
cards.example_zh: 天黑后，花灯把人们吸引到了广场上。

cards.example_en: Add a little pepper to the eggs.
cards.example_zh: 往鸡蛋里加一点胡椒。

cards.example_en: Fifty per cent of the class passed.
cards.example_zh: 班上百分之五十及格了。

cards.example_en: The weather was perfect for flying kites on Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 星期天的天气非常适合放风筝。

cards.example_en: The drama club will perform a short play on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 戏剧社星期五将表演一个短剧。

cards.example_en: Perhaps we can meet after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 也许我们午饭后能见面。

cards.example_en: During that period, we lived above a small bakery.
cards.example_zh: 在那段期间，我们住在一家小面包店的楼上。

cards.example_en: The kind person returned my lost wallet yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天，那位好心人士把我丢失的钱包还了回来。

cards.example_en: Each pupil has a personal locker in the changing room.
cards.example_zh: 每个学生在更衣室都有一个个人储物柜。

cards.example_en: Their pet is a quiet white cat.
cards.example_zh: 他们的宠物是一只安静的白猫。

cards.example_en: My phone rang in the middle of maths class.
cards.example_zh: 数学课上到一半，我的电话响了。

cards.example_en: This photo shows Grandma standing in her garden.
cards.example_zh: 这张照片里，奶奶站在她的花园中。

cards.example_en: Physics explains how light travels.
cards.example_zh: 物理解释光如何传播。

word.example_en: She walked out of the lecture hall.
Cut out the repeated sentence.
Some animals may die out if we do nothing.
word.example_zh: 如果我们什么都不做，有些动物可能会灭绝。

word.example_en: Put out the fire before you leave camp.
They set out early with a small bag.
word.example_zh: 他们带一个小包很早动身。

word.example_en: It takes time to get over a cold.
Please hand over the lab keys.
Who will take over as captain?
Think over the offer tonight.
word.example_zh: 今晚仔细考虑这个提议。

word.example_en: Practice gives you an advantage over guesswork.
word.example_zh: 练习给你胜过瞎猜的优势。

word.example_en: I will take part in the singing contest.
Clubs play a part in school life.
word.example_zh: 社团在校园生活中起一份作用。

word.example_en: We have a party at the end of term.
word.example_zh: 我们在学期末举办聚会。

word.example_en: In the novel, the old sailor will pass away at dawn.
word.example_zh: 小说里，老水手将在黎明去世。

word.example_en: A good teacher is patient with students.
I will pay for the tickets.
Daily practice will pay off.
Our class will pay a visit to the museum.
word.example_zh: 我们班将去拜访博物馆。

word.example_en: Pay attention to the last example.
May I take a photo of the bridge?
word.example_zh: 我可以给这座桥拍照吗？
